changes: Demo offers draw three distinct eligible cards from all nine existing effects and two demo strategies, using a shared demo weight scale.
At most one bonus-map-only card per offer; disabled, non-positive-weight, consumed one-time, and maxed strategy cards are excluded.
Choice IDs identify consumed effects independently of list order.
The +20% run score upgrade remains through combo, ball-out and round changes; resets with a new run.

originalScoreBugReproduction.scope: Tests against the pre-fix source demonstrate the old upgrade loss; the corrected full and demo variants pass.

realSceneFlow.scope: Real release scenes/prefabs, serialized callbacks, intro/banner/retry coroutines. Seeded random offers exercise specific upgrade callbacks without replacing the real choice pool. Ball held stationary; real accepted bumper-trigger callbacks drive round scoring. Steam SDK disabled only in this editor audit; not a manual physics or client authentication test.

steam.buildReviewNotesScope: Review target 26525930; launch executable, controls, demo scope and languages; previous-build second-PC test and lack of a second-PC manual retest of this candidate; 44 automated tests and 149 instrumented scene checks; November 15 AIGEN deadline without claiming expedited approval.
steam.differentPcTestEvidence: User confirmed playing the Steam demo on another PC and discovering the fixed-choice problem there. This was before candidate-v3; the exact installed Build ID on that PC was not independently captured.
